## Summary

• Includes the full `release` branch (68 commits) into `main`, including the Next.js 16 + Bun/Node 22 upgrade and related tooling/config updates.
• Adds the new E2E test suite (auth, landing, sidebar, dashboard, trades, all-trades) and associated test setup/utilities.
• Delivers large cleanup and UI work: dead code/feature removal, shadcn/theme refactors, theme enhancements, and bug fixes (dashboard date filter, account-change refresh, Safari monthly chart sorting).

## Test plan

• Run `bun install` and verify lockfile/tooling consistency
• Run `bun run lint`
• Run `bun run type-check`
• Run `bun run test` (unit/integration)
• Run `bun run test:e2e` (or CI e2e workflow)
• Smoke test key flows: auth, dashboard date filter, all-trades, trade entry save behavior, theme switching, Safari dashboard chart sorting

Made with <https://cursor.com|Cursor>

# <https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/compare/v1.16.0...v1.17.0|1.17.0> (2026-02-20)

### Bug Fixes

• *account-change:* fix issue with all-trades not updating on account change (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/7772a8fbe518b14ccd255ab8d60631818aa6dd24|7772a8f>)
• *dashboard:* fix date filter bug where open trades are not included (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/b371a226b3ca4621c38835e68a2e1dfd121c063a|b371a22>)
• *e2e:* exclude e2e from vitest (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/d9791b3ca3cffee416494846206514fe2726a603|d9791b3>)
• *global-strategies:* Update migration with manually added production global strategies (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/68ea158c8d79a0e61e2246c4e7eaa7f2a37d16fd|68ea158>)
• *re-render:* Fix re-render with resize (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/cab74f201a1ddb5242b1a1828fd9650170e024ea|cab74f2>)
• *safari-dashboard-monthly-chart:* fix Safari browser sorting issue. (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/801fcf70fc2a264c9eb0904cf42f37fd5b5cb164|801fcf7>)
• *seed.sql:* Update seed.sql with correct data, prepping for e2e testing (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/07110f554d14e121f18282ffab866fe70776df8e|07110f5>)
• *trade-entry:* avoid save button clicked multiple times while waiting for form to be submitted (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/a1f409414fec3df12c6932b8cad6c0d600714695|a1f4094>)
• *ui-errors:* Fix dashboard date filter errors and improve UI on certain pages (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/1b277cad74f40424d4480e16eb4ed2a4a8b96450|1b277ca>)

### Features

• *theme:* add themes and theme selector to sidebar (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/6197618c3f8d85a01b79836e8fd638c654d0b748|6197618>)
• *themes:* add theme switch tracking (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/be5de26f6e3368712a5cd4d84ca70a8381f22250|be5de26>)
• *update-packages:* Update to nextjs 16, eslint, tailwindcss4, update all shadcn ui, theme (<https://github.com/MindTrajour/mindtrajour-app/commit/1ee2a1324865adad9fc48935d1252b193b788db6|1ee2a13>)
